files.description:
A large gas weed torch burning for several seconds. Could make a good flamethrower sound.

Recorded: August 2014, with Android Voice Recorder (mono), outdoors/backyard in the afternoon.
files.author: SyntaxSeed

files.freesoundName: Blow Torch: intense, steady roar of ignited flame, sharp hiss of gas release, occasional crackling sparks, and a low rumble as heat intensifies.
files.description: A blow torch produces a fierce, steady roar that’s unmistakable and powerful. When it’s ignited, there’s an initial sharp hiss as the gas flows, followed by a low, continuous rumble as the flame stabilises. The sound is dense, with an underlying rush of air mixed with occasional crackles as the heat

files.description:
A large gas weed-torch being lit. Includes the clicking of the starter and one false-start then a few seconds of burning. Would make a good flame-thrower sound.

Recorded: August 2014, with Android Voice Recorder (mono), outdoors/backyard in the afternoon.
